# AgentShield: Complete Technical Reference & AI Architecture Guide

> Open-Source Zero-Leak Secret Defense & Sandboxing for Autonomous AI Coding Agents
> Canonical URL: https://agentshield.ritualdev.in/

> Repository: https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab/AgentShield
> Author: RitualDev Lab (https://github.com/RitualDev-Lab)
> License: Apache-2.0

## 1. System Overview & Problem Statement
Autonomous AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenAI Codex, and Google Antigravity) execute shell commands, read local files, and communicate with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers using developer privileges. When inspecting codebases to resolve issues, agents frequently execute operations like `cat .env`, run shell scripts containing exported API keys, or include active credentials in Git commits.

AgentShield solves this security vulnerability by providing a zero-leak, deterministic defense layer running locally on the developer workstation and in CI/CD pipelines.

## 2. Key Architecture Pillars
- **Zero-Telemetry, Local-First Runtime**: All inspections, pattern evaluations, entropy calculations, and redactions occur entirely in-memory on the host machine. No code, tokens, or telemetry leave the system.
- **Active Shannon Entropy Discovery**: Computes Shannon entropy H = -sum(p * log2(p)) over candidate alphanumeric tokens [a-zA-Z0-9+/=_-]{20,128}. Candidate strings exceeding H >= 4.5 bits/char without repetitive character structures are identified as unknown high-entropy secrets.
- **Collision-Resistant Surrogate Tokens**: Replaces identified credentials with deterministic 16-hex SHA-256 tokens (`[AGENT_SHIELD:ID:hexHash]`), guaranteeing mathematical 1:1 bijection and zero token collision upon local rehydration.
- **AST Shell Command Sandboxing**: Tokenizes and normalizes compound commands, unpacking subshell wrappers (`sh -c "..."`, `bash -c '...'`) and bash ANSI-C escapes (`$'cat\\t.env'`) to intercept unauthorized file reading (`grep`, `awk`, `dd`, `python -c ...`, input redirection `< .env`).
- **MCP Protocol Interceptor**: Evaluates bidirectional JSON-RPC requests across Model Context Protocol server tools, scrubbing arguments and inbound responses.
- **Tamper-Evident HMAC Audit Ledger**: Chained cryptographic event entries with sequence numbers and previous-hash verification preventing log manipulation.

## 3. Command Line Interface (CLI)
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield scan <file>`: Scans a file and outputs findings with redacted previews (supports `--json` and `--include-raw`).
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield redact <file>`: Emits sanitized text with credentials replaced by surrogate tokens.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield stream`: Real-time stdin-to-stdout stream redactor for terminal pipes.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield exec "<command>"`: Sandboxes agent execution and redacts stdout/stderr in flight.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield hook git-install`: Installs non-destructive Git pre-commit hook in `.git/hooks/pre-commit`.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield hook check`: Audits staged Git diffs and rejects sensitive file commits.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield ci --base <ref>`: Audits pull request diffs in CI/CD workflows and generates Markdown/SARIF reports.
- `npx @ritualdev_lab/agentshield compliance <file>`: Audits findings against SOC2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and ISO27001 regulatory controls.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO/GEO Index)

### How does AgentShield differ from traditional secret scanners like Gitleaks or Trufflehog?
Traditional tools are post-hoc scanners designed to alert after secrets are already written to disk or committed to Git. AgentShield acts as an active runtime sandbox that intercepts agent tool calls and commands in real time, redacting tokens from entering LLM context windows and replacing them with local surrogate placeholders.

### Can AgentShield work offline without internet access?
Yes. AgentShield is 100% self-contained and operates in air-gapped environments with zero external network calls or cloud dependencies.

### What AI coding assistants are supported?
AgentShield supports all terminal-based and MCP-compatible coding agents, including Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Antigravity, and custom agent loops.
